<documents>
<document id="disputes-pending">
Whyˆcan'tˆIˆdisputeˆaˆpendingˆtransaction?ˆYouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆaˆtransactionˆwhileˆit'sˆstillˆpending.ˆAˆpendingˆtransactionˆisˆanˆauthorization.ˆTheˆmerchantˆhasn'tˆcollectedˆtheˆmoneyˆyet,ˆandˆtheˆamountˆcanˆstillˆchangeˆorˆdisappear.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆWaitˆforˆtheˆtransactionˆtoˆpost.ˆMostˆpendingˆtransactionsˆpostˆorˆdropˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆOnceˆitˆposts,ˆtheˆDisputeˆoptionˆappearsˆwhenˆyouˆtapˆit.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆitˆFreezeˆyourˆcardˆnow,ˆevenˆthoughˆyouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆyet.ˆThatˆstopsˆanyˆmoreˆcharges.ˆWhenˆtheˆtransactionˆposts,ˆdisputeˆitˆasˆunauthorized.ˆYourˆdisputeˆwindowˆstartsˆfromˆtheˆstatementˆitˆpostsˆon,ˆsoˆyouˆwon'tˆloseˆtimeˆbyˆwaiting.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆamountˆisˆwrongˆPendingˆamountsˆareˆoftenˆestimates,ˆforˆexampleˆatˆgasˆpumpsˆorˆhotels.ˆTheˆpostedˆamountˆisˆusuallyˆdifferent.ˆWaitˆandˆseeˆwhatˆposts.ˆ##ˆIfˆit'sˆbeenˆpendingˆaˆlongˆtimeˆSomeˆmerchantsˆtakeˆlonger.ˆIfˆaˆtransactionˆhasˆbeenˆpendingˆmuchˆlongerˆthanˆusual,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆlookˆatˆit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-pin">
SettingˆorˆchangingˆyourˆPINˆYouˆsetˆyourˆPINˆwhenˆyouˆactivateˆyourˆcard,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆitˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆChangeˆyourˆPINˆ1.ˆTapˆCards,ˆthenˆCardˆsettings.ˆ2.ˆTapˆChangeˆPIN.ˆ3.ˆConfirmˆit'sˆyouˆwithˆyourˆpasscodeˆorˆfaceˆorˆfingerprintˆunlock.ˆ4.ˆEnterˆtheˆnewˆPINˆtwice.ˆTheˆnewˆPINˆworksˆrightˆawayˆatˆcardˆterminals.ˆSomeˆATMsˆoutsideˆtheˆBrookLinkˆnetworkˆonlyˆpickˆupˆtheˆnewˆPINˆafterˆyourˆfirstˆchip-and-PINˆpurchase.ˆ##ˆForgotˆyourˆPINˆUseˆChangeˆPINˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtheˆoldˆone,ˆbecauseˆtheˆappˆalreadyˆknowsˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆLockedˆPINˆAfterˆseveralˆwrongˆtries,ˆATMsˆandˆterminalsˆwillˆrefuseˆtheˆPIN.ˆChangingˆtheˆPINˆinˆtheˆappˆunlocksˆit.ˆ##ˆKeepˆitˆprivateˆTallowbrookˆstaffˆwillˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆPIN.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆseeˆitˆeither.ˆAnyoneˆwhoˆasksˆforˆit,ˆbyˆphone,ˆtext,ˆemailˆorˆchat,ˆisn'tˆus.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fx-fees-plus-v2">
ForeignˆtransactionˆfeesˆonˆPlusˆOnˆtheˆPlusˆplan,ˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆ##ˆWhenˆitˆappliesˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆinˆaˆstoreˆorˆonlineˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroad.ˆThoseˆhaveˆtheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆaˆpurchaseˆconvertsˆtoˆaˆgivenˆdollarˆamount,ˆtheˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆthatˆamount.ˆIt'sˆaddedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆcalledˆ"Foreignˆtransactionˆfee",ˆonˆtheˆsameˆdayˆtheˆpurchaseˆsettles.ˆ##ˆExchangeˆrateˆWeˆuseˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles,ˆwithˆnoˆmarkup.ˆChooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆwhenˆaˆterminalˆoffersˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆdollars.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆIfˆaˆforeignˆpurchaseˆisˆrefunded,ˆweˆalsoˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆamount.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆconvertedˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆIfˆyouˆtravelˆoften,ˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
